def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(v for r in g for v in r), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    done=set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==bg or (c,i,j) in done: continue

            if not ok: continue
            interior=[(ii,jj) for ii in range(i+1,i2) for jj in range(j+1,j+W-1)]
            if all(g[ii][jj]==bg for ii,jj in interior):
                fillv=7 if len(interior)%2==1 else 2
                for ii,jj in interior: g[ii][jj]=fillv
            for ii in range(i,i2+1):
                for jj in range(j,j+W):
                    done.add((c,ii,jj))
    return g
